description: Botanical illustration status per catalogue plant, in catalogue order. Derived from repository state by tools/botanical_status.py; see docs/BOTANICAL_STATUS.md. Only status=missing enters the generation queue.

statusDefinitions.missing: no botanical PNG master and no botanical WebP in either repository and no reservation; the status the generation queue picks up
statusDefinitions.pending_review: not approved by a person: a generated image delivered but not imported yet (reservation, assetForm none), an imported image awaiting approval, an image confirmed by filename match only (approvalBasis=filename_match_only), or a half-published image
statusDefinitions.approved: PNG master and WebP both exist, hashes agree and data/botanical-verification.json carries an explicit manual approval (approvedAt)
statusDefinitions.rejected: manual: image rejected; regenerate only when explicitly requested
statusDefinitions.uncertain_match: manual or hash-mismatch: identity or file integrity in doubt; never counted as approved
